title: Bridge records of 5,000-line agent edits, with a jiggler on Windows

records.why: A transcript-derived heartbeat with ai_prompt_length 90 becomes a prompt with no text (DESIGN 5.7). SM 2.2 rule 6 holds: the jiggler gave input in the 10 s before it and VS Code, which hosts the extension, has focus. 90 characters: substantive, with the typing lead only (D4). Level C: a bridge anchor with no keyboard input and no log reader for the harness (5.2, 6.4). It passed the peer-process check, so it counts toward logged_s and ai_logged_s (D19).

5,000 changed lines would fill 37,500 s. The bridge's lines fill a turn only up to R_TURN_BASE_S, which the base already reaches (DESIGN 5.2, 5.7). An agent edit, so it counts toward both logged_s and ai_logged_s (D19).

The editor plugin's heartbeat for the agent's change: edit_source agent, so it opens no anchor (DESIGN 5.7). An editor heartbeat that passed the check: it counts toward logged_s, and not toward ai_logged_s, which counts agent events only (SM 5.4).
